methodology.selectionRule: A historical winner is not a shadow candidate unless it also has adequate sample size, positive cost-adjusted validation, acceptable chronological stability, manageable multiple-testing risk, and a credible execution/forward-validation path.
methodology.protectedSplit: NIFTY outcomes for V8/V9 used TRAIN plus VALIDATION (80 sessions) and excluded embargoes and FINAL_HOLDOUT.
methodology.holdoutCaveat: An unaccessed protected final holdout remains unused for V8-V11, but it was not evaluated here and therefore cannot increase confidence. V2-V7 legacy research is explicitly contaminated.
methodology.missingMetricConvention: NOT_EVALUATED means there is no option-outcome evidence; it is not interpreted as zero or positive performance.

candidates.coreSignal: Completed 2m/3m NIFTY reclaim of PDH, OR15, OR30, or recent swing resistance with bullish body, optional RSI/regime confirmation.

representativeCandidate.parameters: 2m, OR30 high, reclaim buffer 0.15 ATR, body >=0.75 ATR, RSI>=50, any except TREND_DOWN, cooldown 15m, +6/-5/20m

candidates.chronology: March was negative (-1.92% net@0.40; 15 settled trades); April +0.42%, May +2.85%, June +3.05%, July has only 3 settled trades. First half was -0.68% net@0.40; second half +3.19%. Two walk-forward folds had only one validation signal each and one was not sign-consistent.
candidates.holdoutStatus: true unseen holdout for this family, not accessed
candidates.multipleTestingRisk: HIGH_OVERFIT_RISK: DSR sensitivity falls to 0.000156 at 4,608 trials and 0.00000085 at 41,472 policy evaluations; simplified PBO=1.0.
candidates.dataQuality: 323/323 required local option sessions complete; no downloads or writes in outcome research.
candidates.executionRisk: Historical option-path costs are flat-cost stresses, not observed bid/ask execution; no forward shadow trades.
candidates.overlap: 0 exact and 0 within +/-5m overlaps against available V2/V4 session-matrix trade references (67/67 signals independent in that estimate).
candidates.newOpportunityCoverage: Yes: bullish CE structural reclaim, but evidence is too regime/month concentrated for Monday shadow.

candidates.coreSignal: Completed 2m/3m NIFTY volatility expansion after compression, directional breakout, optional regime filter, and CE/PE premium return or breakout confirmation.
candidates.timeframe: 2m or 3m signal; 5m volatility context; completed option 1m confirmation
candidates.chronology: PE was positive in each non-empty month (March-June) and both reported walk-forward validation folds were positive, but it has only 43 settled PE trades and no July/August PE observations. CE had a negative April and only nine validation settled trades.
candidates.holdoutStatus: true unseen holdout for this family, not accessed
candidates.multipleTestingRisk: HIGH_OVERFIT_RISK: reported DSR=0 at 960, 8,640, and 25,000-trial sensitivities; simplified PBO=0.5. Broad neighborhood frequency does not cure the selection penalty.
candidates.dataQuality: 902 adapted local option sessions; no missing sessions, downloads, or writes in the outcome run.
candidates.executionRisk: Option premium confirmation uses cached candles and flat costs only; no bid/ask forward execution record for V9.
candidates.overlap: OVERLAP_NOT_ESTIMABLE: V2/V4 artifacts available to the V9 runner lacked exact timestamp references.
candidates.newOpportunityCoverage: Potentially yes: volatility-state and premium-confirmed, direction-neutral coverage; insufficient independent evidence for shadow launch.

candidates.family: BANK NIFTY impulse leading NIFTY confirmation
candidates.coreSignal: ATR-normalized BANK NIFTY impulse followed by NIFTY directional close or micro-break confirmation while NIFTY has not already made the corresponding move.
candidates.metrics: NOT_EVALUATED: no option outcomes, costs, trade returns, drawdown, or validation performance were run.
candidates.signalEvidence: Average measured lead time was only 0.596 minutes and 75.66% of signals were same-bar. Highest-frequency configuration produced 57.725 signals/session. Phase-1 conclusion was LEAD_LAG_HYPOTHESIS_NOT_SUPPORTED.
candidates.multipleTestingRisk: Not estimable because no outcomes were evaluated; the phase-1 structural diagnostic itself rejected the lead premise.
candidates.dataQuality: Local-only diagnostics; all no-lookahead/misalignment/duplicate checks reported zero violations.
candidates.executionRisk: No NIFTY option outcome or execution evidence.
candidates.overlap: Not evaluated; cross-underlying timestamp coincidence would measure timing concentration rather than duplicate signals.
candidates.newOpportunityCoverage: No credible independent lead-lag coverage under the frozen definition.

candidates.family: Option-surface IV skew and risk-reversal pressure
candidates.coreSignal: Causal changes in +/-1 or +/-2 wing IV skew and risk reversal, normalized with prior-only median/MAD baselines, optionally confirmed by a completed underlying candle.
candidates.metrics: NOT_EVALUATED: no trade outcomes, cost stress, validation returns, drawdown, or execution performance exist.
candidates.signalEvidence: All 288 CE and all 288 PE configuration-directions exceeded 2 signals/session; median frequency was about 10 signals/session and maximum about 39.5. This is an implausibly dense signal stream for an episode-suppressed surface-pressure family and is not a deployable result.
candidates.multipleTestingRisk: Not estimable without outcomes; high signal density makes outcome search especially vulnerable to selection bias.
candidates.dataQuality: Feature cache has 29,832 rows; 100% prepared wing coverage and zero reported causal/synchronization violations. Large strike-roll, baseline-unavailable, and zero-MAD rejection counts are expected diagnostics and must remain visible.
candidates.executionRisk: No outcome or forward bid/ask evidence; IV assumptions are fixed research assumptions rather than executable quotes.
candidates.newOpportunityCoverage: Conceptually independent IV-surface coverage, but not yet a credible strategy candidate.

candidates.family: Forward option depth / order-book feature collection
candidates.coreSignal: None: V12 deliberately records deterministic depth, queue-imbalance, spread, microprice, and CE/PE cross-surface features only.
candidates.timeframe: Raw depth plus causal 5s, 15s, 30s, and 60s aggregates
candidates.metrics: NOT_EVALUATED by design; no signal, outcome, or forward session manifest exists yet.
candidates.holdoutStatus: unavailable: forward data collection has not yet accumulated clean sessions
candidates.multipleTestingRisk: Not applicable before a frozen signal design; do not optimize from collection data without a predeclared protocol.
candidates.dataQuality: Collector is implemented but has not been run against a market session; depth fields depend on live Upstox feed availability.
candidates.executionRisk: Designed to measure execution quality, but it has no observations yet.
candidates.newOpportunityCoverage: Potentially the most independent future source, but currently INSUFFICIENT_FORWARD_DATA.

candidates.coreSignal: OR15/OR30 breakout, later retest and bullish/bearish confirmation with regime/body/retest-expiry controls.
candidates.timeframe: 1m, 2m, or 3m; BANK NIFTY monthly-expiry option universe

representativeCandidate.role: highest quality / cost robust combined candidate

candidates.chronology: The apparent best candidate weakens from positive TRAIN to negative VALIDATION. The best-balanced alternative is negative in TRAIN and positive in VALIDATION; months include a material May loss. No stable directional pair was demonstrated.
candidates.multipleTestingRisk: MODERATE_OVERFIT_RISK in artifact; DSR=0 under reported trial sensitivities and simplified PBO=0.5 across 69,984 policy evaluations.
candidates.dataQuality: 99 eligible underlying/metadata sessions; 590 complete plus 4 usable-sparse option sessions, with no incomplete sessions. Five dates lack expiry metadata and are excluded.
candidates.executionRisk: Monthly BANK NIFTY expiry metadata limitation and only historical option-path evidence; no forward execution evidence.
candidates.overlap: Not estimated; NIFTY V2/V4 timing overlap would be portfolio-correlation, not a duplicate signal identity.
candidates.newOpportunityCoverage: Cross-index and both-direction opportunity coverage exists, but not at credible validated expectancy.

Historically attractive small pockets, but validation reversal, 69,984 evaluations, legacy contamination, and rejected artifact verdict.

mondayRecommendation.reason: No candidate simultaneously has adequate non-selected evidence, acceptable multiple-testing diagnostics, stable chronology, and forward execution evidence. Deploying V8 or V9 would turn a selected legacy historical pocket into a live experiment without clearing the project’s own research-to-shadow gate.
mondayRecommendation.mondayOperations: Continue frozen V2 paper and frozen V4 shadow only. Run V12 collection during market sessions; do not create any V8-V11 shadow runtime.
